landing.description: Tokenize real-world assets with institutional-grade compliance baked into every transfer. Built on Solana's Token-2022 with transfer hooks, on-chain KYC, and automated yield distribution.
landing.howItWorksDesc: From asset creation to yield distribution, every step is enforced on-chain.
landing.step01.title: Create Asset
landing.step01.description: Issuer tokenizes a real-world asset using Token-2022 with built-in compliance extensions.
landing.step02.title: Verify Identity
landing.step02.description: Investors pass on-chain KYC verification. A soulbound attestation is minted to their wallet.
landing.step03.title: Compliant Transfers
landing.step03.description: Every token transfer is validated by a Transfer Hook program enforcing regulatory rules.
landing.step04.title: Distribute Yield
landing.step04.description: Income is distributed pro-rata to verified holders automatically through the protocol.
landing.keyFeaturesDesc: Institutional-grade compliance primitives, native to Solana.
landing.feature.transferHook.title: Transfer Hook Compliance
landing.feature.transferHook.description: Every transfer is checked by Solana at the protocol level. Non-compliant transfers are rejected before settlement.
landing.feature.kyc.title: On-chain KYC
landing.feature.kyc.description: Soulbound verification tokens prove investor eligibility without exposing personal data on-chain.
landing.feature.yield.title: Yield Distribution
landing.feature.yield.description: Automatic pro-rata income distribution to all verified token holders through a single instruction.
landing.feature.regulatory.title: Regulatory Controls
landing.feature.regulatory.description: Freeze, recall, and attestation audit trail. Full lifecycle compliance from issuance to redemption.
landing.feature.aifc.title: AIFC Ready
landing.feature.aifc.description: Designed for Kazakhstan's Astana International Financial Centre regulatory framework and beyond.
landing.builtOnToken2022Desc: Leveraging Solana's Token Extensions for native compliance — no wrappers, no bridges, no workarounds.
landing.footerDesc: Connect your wallet to explore the protocol, or visit the dashboard to manage assets and verify investors.
